interpretation_rules: Canonical reported-length fields, partial regional reference routes and physical full-current axes are different evidence types. Do not rank them together.
The21 missing both canonical length and reference-route fields are not necessarily devoid of size evidence: Loop retains two published contour summaries outside those fields.
The32 without reference routes differ from the21 missing both fields.
Width capability counts87 and14 were freshly counted in the verified cloud candidate; this does not establish uniform whole-current width or seasonal coverage.
No whole-catalogue seasonal, thickness or uncertainty completeness percentage has been established.
Only a reference reach and source support were added. The measurement collections and their172 scoped-width/463 width-sample records were preserved.
